subject: Can we swap our call?
text:
Hi Nina,

I hope you and the kids had a peaceful weekend and that the house is finally quiet again after all that baking. I meant to call yesterday, but I woke up with a bit of a migraine and ended up napping before I could get anything sorted. I am sorry for going quiet after mentioning the roof estimate two days ago; I did not want to keep you guessing, especially since your neighborly help has been so generous. Would next Tuesday after 4 work for you instead? I can bring over the contractor's quote and the photos I took during the visit, so we can talk through the options without one of us feeling rushed between errands. I also kept the spare package of roof sealant you left with me, just in case you want to inspect it before I toss anything. I noticed the side gate was sticking again, and I think I have a little silicone spray in the basement if you want me to stop by while we chat. There is absolutely no need to clean up or make extra coffee, either. We can sit with a mug, look at the papers, and decide whether it makes sense to call the plumber first. Let me know whether Tuesday feels reasonable, and if another day would suit you better, just say the word. Thanks so much for being understanding, and I hope your week ahead starts more gently than mine did.

Warmly,
R
